name: Toxic / death

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. Two muted organic spore puffs with a hollow low flutter and dusty papery rattles, slowing and dying out. Purple poisonous particulate release. No liquid bubbling, no acid hiss.
